scope: One bounded public-gallery experiment asking a fixed visual model for the body paint, type and facing of additional current Task 1 vehicle boxes. The same model sees a context board and a second tightly cropped board with reversed numbering. Both prompts require NONE for ground. This experiment supplied no new passenger-app measurements.
release_decision: Unmeasured. No expansion deployed and no accuracy estimate is available.

population.privacy: Only these previously authorized public original images were submitted. Neither passenger speech or text, local-only images, EMT footage, independent reference grades nor proposed destinations were supplied.

execution.native_runtime: vLLM 0.19.1, one H100, four CPU cores, 55000 MiB host RAM
execution.reason: Cold-mounted model shards and native startup consumed the first invocation's window. The subprocess timed out before completing and logging its first group of six boards. Its original all-at-once writer returned no model answers. A preliminary local command stopped on a missing local imaging dependency before submitting a GPU call.
execution.cost_basis: An upper resource estimate for 611 seconds at the published on-demand H100, CPU and memory rates. The provider invoice was not measured.

independent_reference.reviewer: Independent AI visual inspection of the original photo and indicated body box, with no experiment answers. This is not human annotation.
independent_reference.sample: 24 distinct original photos, six previously unread boxes in each relative-box-area quartile.
independent_reference.predeclared_gate: The two presentations of the same model must agree on a specific paint and body. Activation would need at least five supportable visible pairs in the independent sample and zero confident colour/body contradictions or obvious nonvehicles among offered identities. There were no model outputs to assess this gate.

separate_zero_inference_archival_compari.scope: Existing individually source- and crop-verified visual captions from the two earlier public car-appearance archives. These are separate archived measurements and are not outputs from the timed-out 35B experiment. No new inference was run.
separate_zero_inference_archival_compari.paint_exact_or_predeclared_alternative: 7/8 exact, 8/8 with acceptable pale white versus cream
separate_zero_inference_archival_compari.body: 6/8 exact. One definite white SUV was called a sedan. One yellow passenger car was too occluded to verify the sedan subtype.
separate_zero_inference_archival_compari.ordinary_phrasing_diagnostic: For each archived vehicle, tested whether a broad request for a car of its stored colour, without a side or on each image side, would add a reference-only option after recomputing stronger existing answers. Six of the 24 wordings could name the target using its broad Task 1 class and crop colour. Five of those still had other unread eligible passenger-car boxes on the requested side. The one remaining diagnostic was a silver car on the left. This check does not establish uniqueness among the smaller uncropped detections or locate any ground.
separate_zero_inference_archival_compari.decision: The single-crop captions failed the specific-body contradiction check and did not justify shipping a passenger-route expansion.

subsequent_experiment_tooling.change_after_run: The reproducible experiment now stages pinned model files with parallel integrity-checked reads. It flushes original-render hash, sequence and reply to disk after each six-board batch. The wrapper reserves time to authenticate only photos whose every required view finished, and keeps an isolated status file for incomplete runs. Fixtures exercised interruption, corruption, reordered inputs and interrupted final writes locally. No second GPU execution was performed.
subsequent_experiment_tooling.local_cost_comparison: 90 previously timed local 8B image calls averaged 12.475 seconds. At that rate, two per-vehicle local calls for 236 bodies would take about 98 minutes of generation alone. This was an estimate for a different model and presentation, not a measured alternative run or accuracy result.
